title: Post
description: plugin → companion. One outbound message. Every post means 'more coming'; done closes the request.

v.description: Protocol version. A shape change is a new version, never an edit of v1 in place.

question.description: Present when the post is the harness ASKING the person something: the text is the question, and it reaches the person as the question card. The person's answer arrives as the next brief's delta, like any message. Sent only to a companion whose hello lists the `question` feature.

id.description: The harness's own id for the question, which the answer names.
